title: ‘ISKCON’, ‘Tantric’, ‘Gorak Nath’: 287 ‘other’ religions briefly listed on Census portal
description: The drop-down menu under the ‘Others’ category in the question pertaining to the respondent’s religion had 287 options for those not choosing from among the six major religions in India. After The Hindu raised a query about the classification, the drop-down menu was removed from the portal.
